description: Return the external identifiers PulseGate holds for one project, and for each one how it arrived and whether anyone has checked that it belongs. Also states `brand`: the judged brand the record wears and whether that brand's maker published it (owner), as search_catalog does; null when it wears none. Makes no claim about whether the software is alive, maintained, or working. identity_check is not a confidence scale: nobody_has_checked means no check was ever made, not a weaker yes. caveats on an identifier are short codes, spelled out once at caveats_url. Look up by slug, or by an identifier you already have.

platform.description: Identifier platform to look up by, e.g. "github_repo" or "npm_package". Use with value.

slug.description: The PulseGate slug of the listing.

value.description: The identifier on that platform, e.g. owner/name for github_repo.

name: lookup_project
title: Read a project's identifier evidence
